forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: Resolved AMBIGUOUS-AS-NO at horizon EOD 2026-06-16. No TIER1-confirmed convened negotiating session between named US and Iranian principals occurred before the horizon. Qatar 17-hour shuttle diplomacy in Tehran ~June 14 classified as intermediary relay per ambiguity_rule — not a convened session with named delegateleaders from both sides. Pakistan-brokered deal text finalized June 14 but formal signing scheduled June 19 in Geneva, outside F1 window. No Iranian MFA statement rescinding the June 1 suspension was issued within horizon.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that talks continue or relay of written messages does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks continue without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; shuttle diplomacy without co-location of named principals = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Hormuz reach >=50 commercial transits/day (7-day avg) before EOD 2026-07-02?
forecasts.delta_reason: PortWatch/AIS data show approximately 5-10 commercial transits per day as of mid-June against pre-war baseline of approximately 94 per day. MOU includes a provision to reopen Hormuz within 30 days of signing — a June 19 signing places the normalization framework at approximately July 19, outside F4 horizon July 2. MCM timelines project weeks to months even under permissive conditions. War-risk P&I cover not reinstated. Reaching a 7-day average of ≥50 transits within 15 days of MOU signing is near-impossible given MCM, insurance, and shipping-confidence timelines. Kpler projects approximately 40 transits per day at 30-day post-signing horizon — below threshold and outside this window.

forecasts.question: Will the Knesset pass the dissolution bill's final reading with a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27 before EOD 2026-07-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: Dissolution bill passed first reading 106-0 in early June, confirming broad coalition intent. However, Haredi parties (UTJ, Shas) entered active Knesset boycott over the Daycare Law; Times of Israel June 2026 reports a senior coalition figure stating the law lacks majority support and will not advance. The boycott prevents scheduling of second and third readings. No election date has been inserted into bill text; the date must be specified before readings two and three complete. Resolving the haredi standoff is the binding constraint with 28 days remaining to horizon — currently stalled. Set 0.30: above Analyst 0.28 to preserve 106-0 baseline coalition-will signal, well below DA 0.62 which did not account for the boycott constraint.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the Knesset passes the dissolution bill in final (third) reading AND that passage specifies a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27, before EOD 2026-07-15.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two TIER1 (Times of Israel/Reuters/AP/JPost) citing the Knesset plenum vote record.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Preliminary/first/second readings without final passage do NOT count; passage that leaves the date to a later committee or sets only a band without a fixed date = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; if a fixed date on/after 27 Oct is set, resolve NO.
